newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Uneventful session.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Uneventful session.

text.p: The after-hours session presented no noteworthy stock transactions during its first half-hour of trading, dealers said on Wednesday.
"There's nothing in particular to report at the moment," said one dealer.

Blue chip stocks closed moderately lower during normal trading hours, while technology and small-cap stocks thrived. The Dow Jones industrial average ended 0.17 percent down to close unofficially at 7290.
The New York Stock Exchange said Wednesday that session one had a volume of 9,000 shares against 9,600 on the previous day, while session two had 1.1 million against 3.7 million.
